request_window_method: The API created fields are whole-second response timestamps, not exact request-start clocks. Estimated starts subtract each response's own prompt_ms+predicted_ms; end_exclusive is one second after its created second to include its rounding uncertainty. Both first-run CSVs span this estimated first window; neither spans the captured window. These are approximate request windows, not synchronized per-event timestamps or TTFT.
